_comment: The runtime objects rwsafe's manifests reference but the repository never renders (AGENTS.md section 8, 4.2): their
names and keys are committed here as the contract; their values are created once by the operator
(DEPLOY_AND_SHARED_HOST_RUNBOOK section 4) and never touch a tracked file, a command argument or the terminal.
tools/deploy/manifest_check.py fails when a manifest references a Secret or ConfigMap key that is neither rendered
nor listed here, and when the rendered build contains a Secret or one of these ConfigMaps.

rwsafe-icap-tls.purpose: Secure ICAP server chain, its PKCS#8 key, and the CA that issued the proxy's client certificate (H-1)

rwsafe-snapshot-signing-key.purpose: Ed25519 policy-snapshot signing key, PKCS#8 PEM, named by its key id (POLICY_SNAPSHOT_CONTRACT.md)

rwsafe-privacy-hmac-key.purpose: 32 random bytes; rwsafe's own masking and pseudonym key, never neXus's (AGENTS.md 4.8)

rwsafe-db-credentials.purpose: ADR-002 roles: rwsafe_app's password (DML; the database's start script and the control plane's datasource) and rwsafe_migrate's (the database owner; Flyway); both config-tree files in the control plane

rwsafe-siem-credentials.purpose: the Splunk HEC token, mounted as a file for RWSAFE_SIEM_HEC_TOKEN_FILE (LOCAL_RUN.md SIEM export); absent when only syslog is used

rwsafe-capture-key.purpose: ADR-009 C3 capture keys, never the privacy key: one <key id>.key per key (base64 of 32 random bytes), `active` naming the key new material is wrapped under, `shredded` listing destroyed key ids one per line (may be empty); mounted whole at RWSAFE_CAPTURE_KEY_DIR (LOCAL_RUN.md Redacted capture, DEPLOY_AND_SHARED_HOST_RUNBOOK section 7.5)

rwsafe-estate.purpose: real names: directory URL and base DNs, the ingress addresses as a regular expression, the estate dictionary, and the directory's CIDR that the deploy's in-memory patch puts into NetworkPolicy rwsafe-control-to-directory (DEPLOY_AND_SHARED_HOST_RUNBOOK section 7.4)

rwsafe-snapshot-public-keys.purpose: the snapshot verification public key per key id (X.509 SubjectPublicKeyInfo PEM), generated with the signing key

rwsafe-siem-destination.purpose: real SIEM destinations: RWSAFE_SIEM_ENABLED, the syslog receiver (host, port, cef or leef), the HEC URL and index, the PEM CA bundle mounted for RWSAFE_SIEM_SYSLOG_CA_FILE and RWSAFE_SIEM_HEC_CA_FILE, and the SIEM receivers' CIDR that the deploy's in-memory patch puts into NetworkPolicy rwsafe-control-to-siem (LOCAL_RUN.md SIEM export, DEPLOY_AND_SHARED_HOST_RUNBOOK section 7.4)

rwsafe-enduser.purpose: the end-user texts' configured values (docs/i18n/README.md placeholders) as RWSAFE_ENDUSER_CONTROLLER_NAME, _DPO_CONTACT, _POLICY_LINK, _RETENTION_METADATA, _RETENTION_REDACTED (retention figures in whole days) for the data plane's pages and the control plane's notice; while one is missing the notice has no version and capture stays off

build._comment: The image build's uncommitted ConfigMaps in the build namespace (deploy/rwsafe/build, PILOT_RUNBOOK.md steps 3-6). Names are renamed with the product name like every other contract name.

rwsafe-build-config.purpose: the tag the build Jobs push (the short commit id being built, `git rev-parse --short=12 HEAD`); not secret, recreated for every build

rwsafe-build-proxy.purpose: the corporate proxy for kaniko's base-image pulls and, as stage-scoped build arguments, Gradle's downloads in the Containerfiles' build stage (GRADLE_OPTS: -Dhttps.proxyHost/-Dhttps.proxyPort/-Dhttp.proxyHost/-Dhttp.proxyPort/-Dhttp.nonProxyHosts); NO_PROXY holds the in-cluster registry; an estate value, created by tools/pilot/build_config.sh from the operator's store; required, with all four keys present (empty on a network without a proxy); never credentials: no userinfo in a proxy URL and no proxyUser/proxyPassword in GRADLE_OPTS (the script refuses them)

rwsafe-build-ca.purpose: the CA bundle kaniko trusts for registry and proxy TLS: the host's own system bundle (public CA material, no secret); required by the build Jobs
